simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to אֲחִירָם (H297) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-pr-m.

simple.summary: אֲחִירָם (ʼĂchîyrâm) means Achiram , an Israelite First listed occurrence: Num 26 38.

definitions.full: H297. Achiram אֲחִירָם proper name, masculine ( brother of ( the ) lofty = Phoenician חרם see חִירָם ; compare אֲבִירָם ) son of Benjamin Num 26:33 (probably = אחרח 1Chr 8:1 see Be) (compare וָרֹאשׁ אֵחִי Gen 46:21 ).
definitions.rootNote: from 251 and 7311 ; brother of height (i.e. high);
